name: Campbell's Condensed Tomato Soup (Prepared with Water)
whyItWorks: Smooth tomato paste blended with wheat flour and sugar without chunks, skins, or seeds. While tomato carries mild natural acidity, preparing with water or lactose-free milk creates a gentle comfort soup during remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dilute with 1 can of water on stovetop. Pair with a plain grilled white bread sandwich.
